title: Davide: Impeachment vote base should only count qualified senators

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The two-thirds threshold in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial should be computed from senators legally and physically qualified to cast a vote, rather than automatically from the Senate’s full 24-member roster, retired chief justice Hilario Davide Jr. said Wednesday. The Constitution provides that no impeached official may be convicted without the concurrence of two-thirds of all Senate members. Davide laid down the position in a memorandum read into the Senate impeachment court record as senator-judges heard amici curiae on the meaning of “all the Members of the Senate” under Article XI, Section 3(6) of the Constitution.
